# Gemify

> Gemify builds simple, powerful Shopify apps for merchants: Bulk Delete Orders, Default Address Lock, and LLMs-full.txt. This file contains the full site content in plain markdown for AI assistants. A shorter index is available at /llms.txt.

Why merchants choose Gemify:

- Shopify Expertise: built by certified Shopify experts who understand daily merchant challenges

Contact: sean.gemify@gmail.com

## Bulk Delete Orders

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/bulk-delete-orders
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/bulk-delete-orders

Clean up a Shopify store by bulk deleting test orders, old data, or unwanted orders with powerful filters and automatic cancellation. Shopify provides no native way to bulk delete orders; deleting hundreds of orders one by one is time-consuming and error-prone.

Solves:

- Test orders cluttering analytics after development and testing
- Cleanup of imported orders after platform migration
- Duplicate orders from system glitches or integration issues
- GDPR / privacy compliance deletion of old order records

Features:

- Powerful filters: date range, order status, financial status, fulfillment status, tags, customer, and more
- Auto-cancel and delete: orders are automatically cancelled before deletion, fulfilled orders handled gracefully
- Job history: track all deletion jobs with detailed logs
- Export reports: detailed records of deleted orders for compliance and audits
- Safe preview: see exactly what will be deleted and confirm before proceeding
- Supports both regular orders and draft orders

Important notes:

- Deleted orders cannot be recovered; the app recommends filtering carefully, testing with small batches, and exporting a backup first
- Deleting orders removes them from Shopify analytics and reports
- Deleting an order does not delete the customer account

Pricing:

- Free plan: 50 bulk delete order/draft order operations
- Complete plan: $36/year, unlimited operations

## Default Address Lock

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/default-address-lock
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/default-address-lock

Prevents Shopify from overwriting customers' default addresses when they ship orders to different locations. Since 2015, Shopify has automatically changed a customer's default address to match the most recent order's shipping address. The app detects order-triggered changes and automatically restores the original default address, while intentional manual updates by the customer are preserved.

Solves:

- Gift stores: customers' default addresses keep changing to gift recipients' addresses
- B2B merchants: buyers shipping to clients end up with incorrect default addresses
- CRM-integrated shops: inaccurate customer data disrupts marketing and fulfillment
- Subscription businesses: one-time gift shipments override recurring delivery addresses

Features:

- Smart detection: distinguishes order-triggered changes from intentional manual updates
- Automatic restoration: reverts automatic overwrites as they happen
- Privacy-first: stores only address IDs, never actual address content; personal data stays in Shopify

Pricing:

- Free: up to 30 orders per month
- Basic: $4.99/month or $49.90/year (up to 100 orders per month)
- Growth: $24.99/month or $249.90/year (up to 500 orders per month)
- Enterprise: $99/month or $990/year (unlimited orders)
- Yearly billing saves 17%

## LLMs-full.txt

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/llms-txt
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/llms-full-txt

Makes Shopify stores AI-ready by generating llms.txt and llms-full.txt files, so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini can understand a store's products, collections, and pages. Just as robots.txt guides search engines, llms.txt guides AI assistants, helping them recommend products and answer customer questions accurately.

Solves:

- Shoppers increasingly research products through AI assistants, which otherwise work from whatever they can scrape
- Storefront HTML is noisy; models read markdown far more reliably
- Hand-maintaining the files across hundreds of products does not scale
- The standard expects files at the root domain; external hosting means extra infrastructure

Features:

- One-click generation of both llms.txt and llms-full.txt from the dashboard
- Choose exactly which products, collections, pages, blog articles, and policies to include
- Custom output: reorder sections and customize formatting
- Served natively: files are published to the theme and served by Shopify at /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt, no extra hosting
- Clean markdown generated from store data via the Shopify GraphQL API
- No customer data accessed: the app only reads store content

Pricing:

- Free: up to 50 items per content type
- Complete: $9.99/month for unlimited products, collections, pages, and blog articles, plus email support

## Pricing & Billing (all apps)

- Every app offers a free plan: Bulk Delete Orders (50 operations), Default Address Lock (30 orders/month), LLMs-full.txt (up to 50 items per content type)
- Billing is handled through Shopify and appears on the regular Shopify invoice
- Cancel anytime by uninstalling the app through the Shopify admin
- Refunds follow Shopify's standard refund policy

## Privacy & Security

- Minimum data collection: only what each app needs (order data for Bulk Delete Orders, customer/address IDs for Default Address Lock, store content for LLMs-full.txt)
- Data is never sold, rented, or traded to third parties
- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), OAuth 2.0 authentication, regular security audits, strict access controls
- After uninstall, minimal data is kept for 30 days to ease reinstallation, then permanently deleted
- GDPR and CPRA compliant; subscribes to Shopify's mandatory compliance webhooks for data subject requests
- Full policy: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/privacy-policy

## Technical Compatibility

- Works with all Shopify plans: Basic, Shopify, Advanced, and Shopify Plus
- Apps operate on the backend and add no scripts to storefront pages, so store loading speed is unaffected
- No technical knowledge required; anyone who can use the Shopify admin can use the apps
- Multiple Gemify apps can be installed together without conflicts

## FAQ

Full FAQ (43 questions): https://gemify-ecom.github.io/faq

Highlights:

- Is it safe to delete orders? Yes, but deletion is permanent. The app auto-cancels orders first; test with small batches and export a backup.
- Will Default Address Lock stop customers updating their own addresses? No. Manual updates through the customer account are always preserved.
- Who can see the files LLMs-full.txt generates? They are publicly accessible on the store's domain and contain only content the merchant chose to include.
- How do I get support? Email sean.gemify@gmail.com; replies within 24 hours on business days.
